svg.text: tray top — the 8 cut-in cells of the chosen chain (red) on the goal grid 1361x1061 at 0.1 mm

orange = the check’s design-edge cells (a >0.2 mm step; 4.4 % of covered); blue = goal-uncovered cells (the silhouette); the 8 red cells sit 3.4 mm (Euclidean) inside the silhouette, at the part’s four corners
